apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.
notes: The official list is not on this page yet; these edits assume it will be added. The page names dated sources for most figures (two portals and a data site read 5.6.2026, the municipal yearbook June 2026, Tax Authority deals of 2023 via a portal). Per the brief, every city-level 3/4/5-room figure was compared with the official median whatever its label: the asking 3-room 2,650,000 vs the official 2,039,500 (10-12.2025, the latest published 3-room quarter) is the clearest conflict; the 4-room asking 3,190,000 vs 2,559,800 and the city averages 2,701,971 / 3,350,000 vs 2,512,500 follow. 2023 neighbourhood deal averages are STALE. Named and dated non-sale figures are kept: per m2, rents, yield 2.9%, listing counts, the municipal yearbook neighbourhood averages (all rooms), the 2-room and 6+ asking prices (labelled as asking), and the five March 2026 deals. Not audited as claims: the if-example 'אם דירת 4 חדרים מוצעת ב-3.45 מיליון שקל' (p@10651), the financing illustration 'פער של 150,000 עד 300,000 שקל' (p@24899), sizes in m2, counts of comparables (5 עד 10). Remaining check.py SUSPECTs (6) are the individual deals of 3-12.3.2026 (tr@17595..18414 and their recap p@18638), which are dated single deals and stay as they are. Official quirks: no 3-room median was published for 1-3.2026 (nor 1-3.2025), so 3 rooms is shown for 10-12.2025 against 10-12.2024; the city medians fell sharply (4 rooms 2,748,200 in 10-12.2025 to 2,559,800 in 1-3.2026, -15.9% in a year; all rooms -18.5% in a year and about -15% in one quarter), worth a second look before publishing. Name mapping: 'כרמים' on the page = official 'הכרמים'; 'הנחלים', 'הפרחים', 'אבני חן', 'הנביאים', 'המגינים' match; 'משואה' (4 rooms 2,915,000) is not named on the page and is not added. Unsure: (a) the 2-room asking price 2,700,000 is kept as a dated asking figure although it sits above the official 3-room deal median; it could be dropped; (b) the neighbourhood table adds rows for הנביאים and המגינים with generic check notes written new; (c) the purchase/rent table loses its gross-yield column (derived from the old prices) instead of recomputing yields.
